Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.smoother

Interface TransitionSmoother

All Known Subinterfaces:
FloatTransitionSmoother, Vector3fTransitionSmoother
All Known Implementing Classes:
AcceleratingFloatSmoother, AcceleratingVector3fSmoother, LinearFloatSmoother, NaturalFloatSmoother, NaturalVector3fSmoother, OscillatingFloatSmoother, SpringFloatSmoother, XYPolarNaturalVector3fSmoother, XZPolarNaturalVector3fSmoother, YAcceleratingVector3fSmoother
public interface TransitionSmoother
The interface that all the TransitionSmoother extend. A TransitionSmoother is a utility classes that generates sequence of values. Typically it keeps an internal value and changes it towards a given target value gradually.
